about.heading: About
paragraphs: I am a PhD candidate in Electrical Engineering at the University of Connecticut, where my research centers on robotics, nonlinear control, and learning-based manipulation of deformable objects.

My work combines adaptive control, barrier Lyapunov methods, reinforcement learning, computer vision, and robot experimentation to design safe and scalable controllers for challenging manipulation tasks.
Alongside research, I support undergraduate and graduate learning as a teaching assistant and have built robotics and vision systems in both academic labs and industry internships.

featuredWork.heading: Featured Work
featuredWork.summary: My current research focuses on vision-based deformable object manipulation, constrained adaptive control, and reinforcement learning for robotic systems, validated in both simulation and real robot experiments.

slides.title: Adaptive shape servoing for deformable objects
slides.description: Developed adaptive controllers that learn deformation models online for vision-based manipulation of deformable objects and validated them through simulation and physical robot experiments.

slides.title: Constrained control with barrier Lyapunov methods
slides.description: Designed constrained control frameworks using integral concurrent learning, barrier Lyapunov functions, and Fourier-series-based Jacobian approximation to enforce safe manipulation under nonlinear state constraints.

slides.title: Learning-based robotic manipulation
slides.description: Implemented an adaptive actor-critic policy iteration algorithm with PCA-based dimensionality reduction to make deformable object learning more scalable for robotic manipulation tasks.

items.title: Constrained Deformable Object Manipulation
items.subtitle: Zeroing barrier function control
items.description: Developed a closed-form constrained controller using a Lagrange multiplier approach and a Zeroing Barrier Function to avoid collisions during cloth manipulation, then validated the controller in NVIDIA Flex.

items.title: Two-Link Planar Robot Control
items.subtitle: Feedback linearization, robust, and adaptive control
items.description: Designed three controllers to track joint trajectories under disturbance and compared their stability guarantees through MATLAB simulations.

items.title: Human Action Recognition Using 2D Skeletal Data
items.subtitle: LSTM sequence modeling with MediaPipe
items.description: Extracted pose data with MediaPipe Holistic, trained an LSTM model in TensorFlow Keras to classify indoor actions, and achieved 83 percent accuracy with TensorBoard-based evaluation.

items.title: Hex-Nut Detection and Width Prediction
items.subtitle: YOLO and MATLAB measurement pipeline
items.description: Built a custom YOLO v3 object detector for hex nuts, used image processing to estimate widths in pixels, and converted those measurements to inches with a reference object for mobile execution.

items.title: Object Detection and Tracking with TensorFlow Lite
items.subtitle: Raspberry Pi and PID control
items.description: Trained a custom SSD MobileNet V2 FPN-Lite detector, deployed it on a Raspberry Pi with TensorFlow Lite, and used a PID-controlled pan-tilt setup for active object tracking.

items.title: SolidWorks Design and Prototyping
items.subtitle: Certified mechanical design work
items.description: Earned SolidWorks associate certification and designed 3D-printed prototypes including a child-friendly Mars Rover replica and a working board game.
